outcome: time to first normal bowel sound
cohort: The study included 324 women over 18 years of age with singleton pregnancies who were candidates for elective cesarean section at Taleghani Hospital in Arak.
finding: Misoprostol and gum-chewing significantly shortened the time to first normal bowel sound, gas passage, and defecation compared to the control group, with misoprostol being more effective than gum-chewing.
